answer: The strongest lever is simple: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because trellis only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, prism is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
